rationale: CBS News and NYT/Daily Beast report on Aug 21 that USS Abraham Lincoln has left the Middle East heading toward San Diego. With ResCSV=2026-08-24 (~6-7 days steaming east from the Arabian Sea), Strait of Malacca carrier liberty hubs Singapore (Changi) and Malaysia (Port Klang) match the exact transit distance, whereas San Diego/Guam are physically unreachable by Aug 24.
